title: Tech Note: Custom Users and Groups Import/Export
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: USERS TO BLOB / BLOB TO USERS
SET PLUGIN ACCESS / Get plugin access

historical_commentary.text: This note builds a custom Users and Groups import/export module (via USERS TO BLOB/BLOB TO USERS plus DOM-based XML serialization) that additionally captures per-plug-in access group assignments, a gap in 4D 2004's built-in import/export feature. The specific plug-in-access commands (SET PLUGIN ACCESS, Get plugin access) target the classic serialized-plug-in licensing model (4D Write, 4D View, 4D Draw, ODBC Pro, etc.) from the mid-2000s, and the XML-via-DOM-commands approach is dated compared to modern JSON/ORDA-based tooling, but the underlying need to programmatically export/import the security model (users, groups, permissions) between databases remains a common administrative task in current 4D.
related_updates: USERS TO BLOB/BLOB TO USERS and the plug-in access commands are legacy classic-4D commands still present for backward compatibility but the plug-in licensing model they target (serialized plug-ins like 4D Write/4D View) has evolved substantially
Modern 4D favors JSON-based data exchange and, for permissions, ORDA/REST-based privilege management over ad hoc DOM-XML serialization
